title: Reverse Linked List - Iterative (JavaScript)
explanation: Iteratively reverse the next pointers while traversing the list.

title: Reverse Linked List - Iterative (Python)
code:
def reverse_list(head):
    prev = None
    curr = head
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev = curr
        curr = nxt
    return prev
explanation: Iteratively reverse pointers with O(1) extra space.
